segments.name: consolidated company
segments.description: Supplies life science tools in proteomics and genomics, including mass cytometry, spatial biology and microfluidics platforms, to biomedical researchers.
segments.evidence: The CyTOF platform includes state-of-the-art instrumentation, optimized reagents, and powerful data analysis tools to accelerate discoveries in immunology, oncology, and beyond.

revenueModel.text: Researchers and clinical customers pay for instruments and consumables, and for field services including instrument service and support contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates product revenue from the sale of instruments and consumables.

changes.text: During the first quarter of 2025 the Company combined its two reportable segments, proteomics and genomics, into one operating and reportable segment.
changes.evidence: During the first quarter of 2025, after the full integration of SomaLogic and assessment of 2024 results, the CODM evaluated how the fully integrated, combined company should be managed.

changes.text: The Company divested its SomaScan Business to Illumina, with the transaction closing in 2026 and the business reported as a discontinued operation.
changes.evidence: On January 30, 2026, the Company completed the divestiture of the SomaScan Business to Illumina.
